name: balanced
description: Default-allow for everyday file edits and test/build commands, default-deny for a short list of clearly destructive patterns, ask for everything else that touches the network or git history. Good default for day-to-day agentic coding.

rules.reason: Blocked by guardrail balanced profile: irreversible system-level command.
Force push requires explicit confirmation under the balanced profile.
Piping a remote download directly into a shell is blocked by guardrail policy.
File edits are auto-approved under the balanced profile.
File writes are auto-approved under the balanced profile.
Reads are always safe to auto-approve.
Common build/test command auto-approved under the balanced profile.
No matching allowlist rule under the balanced profile; defaulting to ask.
